summary: Built interactive drag-and-drop canvas for workflow construction with: workflowValidation.ts utility (isValidConnection, validateWorkflow, getConnectionErrors with cycle detection and type-based rules), useWorkflowEditor hook (useReducer-based state management for nodes/connections/selection/validation), NodePalette component (HTML5 drag API for upload/extract/transform/output node types), WorkflowNode component (draggable nodes with input/output ports and visual feedback), ConnectionLine component (SVG bezier paths with green/red/yellow validation styling), Canvas component (SVG+HTML layered rendering with drop handling and connection drawing), WorkflowEditor container (3-panel layout with palette, canvas, and config sidebar plus validation status bar), route at /workflow-editor in App.tsx, and comprehensive tests (37 new tests all passing). TypeScript compiles cleanly and Vite build succeeds.
